title: Touchdown
description: Touchdown provides an interactive spawn region selection for new players, complete with camera effects and safe teleportation.
body:
[SpigotMC](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/touchdown.131994/) | [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins/touchdown) | [GitHub](https://github.com/GrenkaUkraine/Touchdown)

[NEED ProtocolLib FOR THIS PLUGIN](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/)

**Touchdown** provides an interactive spawn region selection for new players, allowing them to choose their starting location upon first join. The plugin features **camera effects**, **safe teleportation**, **spectator mode navigation**, and **optional AuthMe support** for servers that require login authentication.

### Features
- Interactive spawn region selection for new players.
- Smooth camera movement around selectable regions.
- Safe teleportation to the chosen spawn.
- Spectator mode during selection, with flight enabled.
- Configurable visual effects (particles, titles, action bars).
- AuthMe compatibility: players who log in through AuthMe can still select their spawn.
- Changelog notification for admins.
- Fully configurable via config.yml and language files (lang/*.yml).
 
### Commands
- `/touchdown reload` - Reloads the plugin configuration and language files.
- `/touchdown createregion <id> <display name>` - Creates a new spawn region at the player's current location. Shorthand: `/td cr`.

### Permissions
`touchdown.admin` - Allows access to admin commands (reload, createregion).
